module roman
  purpose: Convert integers from 1 to 3999 to Roman numerals and back.

public type RomanError is one of
  purpose: Why a Roman numeral conversion was rejected.
  OutOfRange(amount: Integer)
  InvalidNumeral(text: Text)
end

type Numeral
  purpose: One Roman symbol together with its integer value.
  has amount: Integer
  has letters: Text
end

function numeral_table()
  returns List of Numeral
  purpose: List every Roman symbol, including subtractive pairs, from largest to smallest.
  example: numeral_table().length() is 13

  return [
    Numeral(amount: 1000, letters: "M"),
    Numeral(amount: 900, letters: "CM"),
    Numeral(amount: 500, letters: "D"),
    Numeral(amount: 400, letters: "CD"),
    Numeral(amount: 100, letters: "C"),
    Numeral(amount: 90, letters: "XC"),
    Numeral(amount: 50, letters: "L"),
    Numeral(amount: 40, letters: "XL"),
    Numeral(amount: 10, letters: "X"),
    Numeral(amount: 9, letters: "IX"),
    Numeral(amount: 5, letters: "V"),
    Numeral(amount: 4, letters: "IV"),
    Numeral(amount: 1, letters: "I")
  ]
end

public function to_roman(number: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 to its Roman numeral.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: from_roman
  example: to_roman(1) is "I"
  example: to_roman(4) is "IV"
  example: to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(3999) is "MMMCMXCIX"

  if number is less than 1 or number is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(amount: number)
  end
  let mutable remaining be number
  let mutable result be ""
  for each entry in numeral_table()
    repeat until remaining is less than entry.amount
      set result to "{result}{entry.letters}"
      set remaining to remaining - entry.amount
    end
  end
  return result
end

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a canonical upper-case Roman numeral from I to MMMCMXCIX to an integer.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: to_roman
  example: from_roman("I") is 1
  example: from_roman("IV") is 4
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") is 3999

  if text.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end
  let mutable remaining be text
  let mutable total be 0
  for each entry in numeral_table()
    repeat until not remaining.starts_with(entry.letters)
      set total to total + entry.amount
      set remaining to remaining.drop(entry.letters.length())
    end
  end
  if not remaining.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end
  let canonical be to_roman(total) otherwise fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  if canonical is not text then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end
  return total
end

test "numbers convert to numerals"
  check to_roman(2024) otherwise crash with "unexpected failure" is "MMXXIV"
  check to_roman(58) otherwise crash with "unexpected failure" is "LVIII"
end

test "numerals convert to numbers"
  check from_roman("MMXXIV") otherwise crash with "unexpected failure" is 2024
  check from_roman("LVIII") otherwise crash with "unexpected failure" is 58
end

test "out of range numbers are rejected"
  match to_roman(4000)
    when success(text) then crash with "expected a failure, got {text}"
    when failure(error) then check error is OutOfRange(amount: 4000)
  end
end

test "non canonical numerals are rejected"
  match from_roman("IIII")
    when success(number) then crash with "expected a failure, got {number}"
    when failure(error) then check error is InvalidNumeral(text: "IIII")
  end
end

  InvalidNumeral(text: Text)
end

type Numeral
  purpose: One Roman symbol paired with its integer amount.
  has amount: Integer
  has symbol: Text
end

function numeral_table() returns List of Numeral
  purpose: List every Roman symbol, including subtractive pairs, from largest to smallest.

  return [
    Numeral(amount: 1000, symbol: "M"),
    Numeral(amount: 900, symbol: "CM"),
    Numeral(amount: 500, symbol: "D"),
    Numeral(amount: 400, symbol: "CD"),
    Numeral(amount: 100, symbol: "C"),
    Numeral(amount: 90, symbol: "XC"),
    Numeral(amount: 50, symbol: "L"),
    Numeral(amount: 40, symbol: "XL"),
    Numeral(amount: 10, symbol: "X"),
    Numeral(amount: 9, symbol: "IX"),
    Numeral(amount: 5, symbol: "V"),
    Numeral(amount: 4, symbol: "IV"),
    Numeral(amount: 1, symbol: "I")
  ]
end

public function to_roman(amount: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an Integer from 1 to 3999 to its Roman numeral.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: from_roman
  example: to_roman(1) is "I"
  example: to_roman(4) is "IV"
  example: to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(3999) is "MMMCMXCIX"

  if amount is less than 1 or amount is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(amount: amount)
  end
  let mutable left be amount
  let mutable result be ""
  for each entry in numeral_table()
    repeat until left is less than entry.amount
      set result to "{result}{entry.symbol}"
      set left to left - entry.amount
    end
  end
  return result
end

public function from_roman(numeral: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a canonical upper-case Roman numeral to an Integer from 1 to 3999.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: to_roman
  example: from_roman("I") is 1
  example: from_roman("IV") is 4
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") is 3999

  let mutable unread be numeral
  let mutable total be 0
  for each entry in numeral_table()
    repeat until not unread.starts_with(entry.symbol)
      set unread to unread.drop(entry.symbol.length())
      set total to total + entry.amount
    end
  end
  if not unread.is_empty() or total is less than 1 or total is greater than 3999 then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: numeral)
  end
  let canonical be to_roman(total) otherwise fail with InvalidNumeral(text: numeral)
  if canonical is not numeral then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: numeral)
  end
  return total
end

test "integers become Roman numerals"
  check roman.to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  check roman.to_roman(3888) is "MMMDCCCLXXXVIII"
end

test "Roman numerals become integers"
  check roman.from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
  check roman.from_roman("XLII") is 42
end
